description: Active shipments not yet arrived whose carrier ETA falls within the next N days, soonest first. Use it for "what arrives this week"; for an exact date range or other filters use list_shipments with eta_after / eta_before. All arguments are optional: days (1-120, default 7), limit (1-200, default 50). Returns: days, shipments[] {id, reference, ref_type, carrier, customer_reference, status, tracking_status, phase, pol, pod, eta, original_eta, delay_hours, predicted_eta, eta_risk, vessel, containers, booking_number, bl_number, tracked_via}. No paging: raise limit or narrow days.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

days.description: Look-ahead window in days from now.

name: list_arriving_shipments
title: Arriving soon
